name: Gotemba (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Gotemba city emblem in brown: a ring open at the lower fly enclosing a stylised Mount Fuji.
history: Municipal flag of Gotemba, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 September 1957.

features.role: Gotemba city emblem — a ring open at the lower fly enclosing a stylised Mount Fuji
